name: application-amenities-grid
title: Amenities Grid
description: Icon+label feature grid where excluded items render dimmed with a strikethrough, computed from a real per-item included flag.
useWhen: Listing a fixed set of features/amenities for a property, plan, or product where some apply and some don't.
Each item benefits from a recognizable icon alongside its label for quick scanning.
You want excluded items to remain visible (crossed out) rather than disappearing, so users see the full feature set.
avoidWhen: All items are always included (nothing to exclude) — a plain icon list is simpler without the included/excluded branching.
You need a full comparison across multiple plans/products side by side — use `feature-comparison-matrix` for that tabular case instead.
Items don't have a natural icon — a plain text list avoids empty or generic icon slots.
responsiveBehavior: Two-column grid by default; adjust grid-cols via className for wider layouts with more amenities per row.
accessibility: Excluded amenities are marked with a real line-through text-decoration, not just faded opacity, so the "not included" meaning survives even without color perception.
Icons are decorative; the amenity name is always present as text, never conveyed by icon alone.
Included/excluded state is computed from a single boolean per item, so icon dimming and strikethrough always agree.

variants.title: Amenities Grid
variants.description: Four included amenities (Wi-Fi, parking, pool, kitchen) and two excluded ones (A/C, elevator) shown crossed out.
accessibility: Excluded styling (dimmed text + strikethrough icon and label) is driven by a single included boolean per amenity.

variants.title: Amenities Grid (Dark)
variants.description: Amenities grid adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Included and excluded text/icon colors are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
